title: The posterior mean uniquely minimizes squared posterior risk
statement: On fibers with finite posterior second moment, the measurable posterior-mean rule uniquely attains finite squared posterior risk; this result assumes AC through the L²-projection supplier.
strategy: Show the posterior mean is the conditional expectation on the trivial sigma-algebra and apply the supplied L² projection theorem.
axiom_use: Assume AC exactly for the published L² conditional-expectation projection theorem.

references.title: Ryan Martin, Lecture Notes on Advanced Statistical Theory, §5.3.1, PDF pp. 104–105
Andrew Gelman et al., Bayesian Data Analysis, 3rd ed., §9.1
